fields.label: Include
fields.description: Unticked rows are not created. The reviewer drops a row rather than deleting it, so the proposal stays a complete record of what the model suggested.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: Refused unless it is one of the two Projects named in Product Feedback Settings. The model does not get to choose where work is written.

fields.label: Expected Hours
fields.description: Written to Task.expected_time. A model's estimate, kept because a wrong number a human can correct beats a blank field nobody fills in.

fields.label: Under Existing Task
fields.description: An existing group task on the same Project to nest under. Preferred over a new group: PRJ-00580 already carries its epics, and a new top-level node per request would bury them.

fields.label: New Group Subject
fields.description: Used only when parent_task is empty. All rows sharing a group_subject land under one newly created group Task.

fields.label: Depends On Row
fields.description: 1-based idx of another row in this same table. 0 means no dependency. Resolved to a Task Depends On row after both tasks exist; self-references and cycles are dropped.

fields.label: Created Task
fields.description: Stamped after creation. Its presence is what makes the confirm call idempotent — a re-run skips any row that already has one.
